tenderSchedule.title: Conducting Third party inspection and quality control and assurance for Lift Irrigation Scheme for Filling up of Indaragi and other 27 Tanks by Lifting water from Tungabhadra River in Gangavathi Taluka, Koppal District.
tenderSchedule.description: Conducting Third party inspection and quality control and assurance for the work Survey, Investigation, Design, Supply, Erection, Testing and commissioning of Lift Irrigation Scheme for Filling up of Indaragi and other 27 Tanks by Lifting water from Tungabhadra River in Gangavathi Taluka, Koppal District comprising of Following components Construction of Jackwell cum pump House, Vertical turbine pumps coupled to HT motors Electrical panel, soft starter, capacitors, Power transformers, 33/6.6 KV substation, 33 KV power line, and 33KV Terminal bay, Rising main, Pressure Distribution network through MS/HDPE/OPVC pipes with installation of surge protection system, supply of spares and tools including operation and maintenance for five years after successful commissioning of the entire system on turnkey basis

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
The Consultant should be empanelled with KNNL/KPWD. Certificate of registration should be enclosed.
All the documents sought under Pre Qualification Criteria are to be uploaded.
A copy of the GST Certificate /Provisional GST Certificate /GST No issued from competent Authority
Latest Copy of the Income tax returns filed for the Financial year 2024-25 (Assessment year 2025-26) or Latest Copy
Employees provident fund (EPF) & Employees State Insurance (ESI) registration certificate.
Valid ISO 9001:2015 Certificate

The bidder should furnish the list of works on hand with all details such as bid cost date of entrustment, stipulated date of completion, actual date of completion, completed cost of work, latest status of work.
Each of the documents uploaded to the e-portal should be self-attested by the contractor or an authorized representative in case of firm/company
The intending bidders are advised to visit the site of work to understand the very nature of work, methodology, technicalities, work preparedness etc., before submission of their tenders.

The necessary certificate /documents in support of eligibility criteria fulfilled as stipulated shall be scanned and attached to their e-tender documents. The original certificates/documents shall be produced on or before stipulated date and time for verification
If any of the dates mentioned above happens to be a general holiday, the next working day is valid.
Further information can be obtained from the office of the Executive Engineer, Quality Control Division, Munirabad during office hours (Phone No 08539-270610.)

Conditional tenders will be rejected and E.M.D. will be forfeited. The officer competent to accept the tender shall have the right to reject any or all the tenders without assigning any reason whatsoever.
Corrigendum will be published in the website only for all modifications/corrections if any.
The contractor should mention their recent correct postal address and e-mail address in the declaration form.
The contractor/firm shall send the authorization letter of their representatives duly attested by their signature.
The Tender processing charges paid by the bidders are non-refundable, even if their tenders are cancelled.
Incomplete tender documents will be summarily rejected
As per the Karnataka building and other construction Workers Welfare Cess Act 1996, 1% of the bill amount will be deducted from each bill.
Tenders will be opened on the due date in presence of the contractor or their authorized agents.
The contractor / Firm / Company should adhere to the accepted action plan submitted by them under any circumstances, without linking to the pending bill payment of the work.
Typo-graphical errors (if any) will not be the ground for any claims by the Contractor.
Tendering by Joint Venture is not acceptable
EMD of the unsuccessful bidders will be refunded only after the acceptance of tenders by the competent authority.
EMD of the Successful bidders will be refunded only after the agreement.
